description: Add real-time SSE notifications. When a new job application is saved via POST /api/applications, all connected browser clients receive a server-sent event and display a toast notification in the top-right corner (auto-dismiss after 5 seconds). Requires: new NotificationService.java, new NotificationController.java, modification of AppUserController.java, new notifications.js, and script tags in all main templates. This feature depends on FEAT-001 (application.js changes) and FEAT-002 (Settings.html already references notifications.js) and FEAT-003 (Contacts.html and Resources.html already reference notifications.js).
steps: Create NotificationService.java at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/java/com/job_tracker/job/tracker/NotificationService.java. Package: com.job_tracker.job.tracker. Imports: org.springframework.stereotype.Service, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.SseEmitter, java.io.IOException, java.util.List, java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList. @Service class NotificationService with field: private final List<SseEmitter> emitters = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>(). Method addEmitter(): creates new SseEmitter(Long.MAX_VALUE), adds to list, registers onCompletion/onTimeout/onError callbacks that remove the emitter from the list, returns the emitter. Method broadcast(String jobTitle, String company): iterates emitters, calls emitter.send(SseEmitter.event().name('new-job').data(jobTitle + ' at ' + company)) in try-catch, collects dead emitters (IOException) in a separate list, removes them after iteration.

Create NotificationController.java at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/java/com/job_tracker/job/tracker/NotificationController.java. Package: com.job_tracker.job.tracker. @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/notifications'). Constructor injection of NotificationService. @GetMapping('/stream') method that returns notificationService.addEmitter() as SseEmitter.

Modify AppUserController.java at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/java/com/job_tracker/job/tracker/AppUserController.java. Add NotificationService as a constructor-injected dependency (update the constructor to accept both AppRepository and NotificationService). In saveApplication, after 'return repository.save(application)' — change to: AppUser saved = repository.save(application); notificationService.broadcast(application.getJobTitle() != null ? application.getJobTitle() : 'New Job', application.getCompany() != null ? application.getCompany() : 'Unknown Company'); return saved;

Create notifications.js at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/resources/static/js/notifications.js. IIFE that: (1) defines a showToast(message) function that creates a div.sse-toast, appends to #toast-container (creating the container if it does not exist), adds class sse-toast--visible after a rAF tick, removes the toast after 5 seconds with a fade-out transition. (2) exposes window.showToast = showToast. (3) If EventSource is defined, creates new EventSource('/api/notifications/stream'), adds event listener for 'new-job' events that calls showToast('🆕 New job added: ' + event.data). onerror silently ignored (browser auto-reconnects).

Add <script th:src='@{/js/notifications.js}'></script> before </body> in Applications.html at /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main/src/main/resources/templates/Applications.html (after the existing application.js script tag).

Add <script th:src='@{/js/notifications.js}'></script> before </body> in Settings.html (this was created in FEAT-002 — it already has a forward reference; now that notifications.js exists, the script tag is active).

In application.js, after the statusMessage.textContent = '✅ Application saved!' line, add: if (typeof window.showToast === 'function') { window.showToast('Application saved: ' + applicationData.jobTitle + ' at ' + applicationData.company); }
Run ./mvnw compile -q from /home/simon/Downloads/JOB-TRRACKER-main and confirm exit code 0.
